INTERIOR ROOMINESS
SO THIS IS WHAT A PERFECT
FIT LOOKS LIKE.
P erhaps you’re thinking we’ve printed the wrong photograph on this page? Slipped in an
interior shot of our Genesis luxury sedan, maybe? Nope. That’s an Elantra. If it looks
roomier than the typical compact sedan, that’s because it is roomier. In fact, Elantra is
so spacious inside, the U.S. government classifies it as a midsize car, not a compact.
And here’s where you’ll notice the difference: Elantra has more front legroom than the Honda
Civic and Toyota Corolla. Elantra also has more total space and cargo volume than the Honda
Civic, too.1
But it’s what we did with all of that space that really matters. For starters, we made it
comfortable, with available heated seats front and rear. Elantra’s available dual zone
automatic temperature control system features a CleanAir Ionizer, and the power driver seat
comes with lumbar support. We made all of the seating environmentally friendly as well by
using a soy-based material for the foam cushions.
And we made Elantra’s technology seamless, with a Bluetooth® hands-free phone system that
lets you make calls and stream music from your compatible smartphone using simple voice
commands. We made it intelligent, too, with proximity key entry, push-button start, a rearview
camera and a navigation system that features SiriusXM Travel Link® services (traffic, weather,
movie times, fuel prices, stocks, sports and more).2
We made it, in other words, perfect.
